content.text: {"summary": "Duplicate settlement webhooks no longer double-credit merchants. Each bank event is recorded once in a new processed_events table inside the crediting transaction; repeats return 'duplicate'. Verified by unit tests, hidden concurrency tests and a replay of recorded traffic with duplicates.", "risks": ["New table: confirm the migration runs before the new code is deployed", "Duplicate deliveries now return status 'duplicate'; check the bank does not treat that as an error"]}
